patch.value: Raise the pm-graph engine from 63% line coverage toward the 100% mandate

pm-graph is the canonical 'pm graph' engine and its entire implementation is a single 3419-line src/index.ts sitting at 63.xx% lines / 76% branches / 77% functions. The coverage gate passes only because coverageGate.thresholds were pinned to that measured floor last session rather than to the 100/100/100/100 mandate, so more than a third of the graph engine ships unexercised. The existing suite (analytics, diagram-commands, explain-command, export-and-contract, id-resolution, impact-command, smoke) covers the happy paths; what is missing is the branch and error surface. This is coupled to the already-open pm-graph-v7k3, because replacing the list-all shell-outs with the in-process SDK item reader removes a child-process boundary that currently makes large parts of the engine awkward to exercise directly.

src/index.ts line, branch and function coverage all rise substantially toward 100 with no threshold lowered anywhere; coverageGate.thresholds are ratcheted up to the newly measured floor so the gain cannot regress; new tests assert real graph behaviour including cycle, missing-node and malformed-edge error paths rather than only happy paths; no new 'any', no inline imports, erasable TypeScript only; npm run check and npm run coverage both pass

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Finished the coverage push. Fixed the 12 failing tests left by the prior session: (1) export-format assertions now read result.__pmGraphRawOutput (the wrapped payload the host output-format override unwraps) instead of stdout, asserting real MERGE/@startuml/digraph/GraphML; (2) the 7 dispatch-engine error paths converted to assert.rejects over the thrown CommandError, asserting the real exitCode (USAGE=2/NOT_FOUND=3/GENERIC_FAILURE=1) and message; (3) the 60s Neo4j connect test now points at a closed local port with env-overridable NEO4J_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS/NEO4J_MAX_RETRY_MS (added to createDriver with unchanged production defaults), failing in ~1.4s. Added genuine branch coverage (criticalConnectors articulation/bridge/back-edge, explainItem Integer-unwrap + fallbacks, renderer non-string-title fallback, multi-node cycle/path/chain/depth/reverse-reachable analytics, query destructive-keyword guard, exporter depth/root/output/filter validation). Coverage 63/76/77 -> measured 82.6 lines / 78.1 branches / 89.5 functions (192 tests, 0 failing); thresholds ratcheted to 81/77/88. v7k3 was already committed (e714a1d); removed a leftover orphan docblock describing the removed pm list-all shell-out. Gates: check/coverage/audit:prod/pack:dry-run all exit 0.

value.text:
Verified by Claude (orchestrator) independently of the agent report: npm run check exit 0, npm run coverage exit 0 at 82.62 lines / 78.10 branches / 89.53 functions, 192 tests 0 failing, audit:prod and pack:dry-run exit 0. PR unbraind/pm-graph#46.

Two corrections applied during verification:
1. The refactor commit message had ~94 KB of 'pm list' JSON output accidentally piped into it. Squashed the two local commits into one 4.7 KB message before pushing.
2. Confirmed the deps/dependencies flattening is preserved through the ItemMetadata switch. Dropping the legacy deps[] field would have silently lost edges on older trackers, so that was the highest-risk part of the refactor to check.

Remaining gap tracked, not silently dropped: the suite is green but slow at ~226s, with two export-shaping tests at ~16s each because they spawn the pm CLI to build real workspaces. The 60s Neo4j-timeout test IS fixed (now ~1.4s).
